name: Find Lover
steps: Hide the suspicious person from the partner.
Use the “neighbor returning a blanket” excuse.
Pretend the person is fixing the bed.
Claim the person is painting the wedding photo.
Say they are testing the shower.
Continue hiding the person as the partner investigates.
Use the “cuckoo clock bird” costume excuse.
Claim the person is fixing the AC.
The partner discovers the truth and completes the level.
